name: TB-500
subtitle: Thymosin Beta-4 fragment
summary: Synthetic fragment of Tβ4, logged for whole-body recovery rather than a single injury site.
caveat: A synthetic fragment — the human exposure data belongs to full-length Tβ4, not to TB-500 itself.
